english.notes: Must be met in one sitting; results valid two years. IELTS One Skill Retake accepted. value.description: No published grade threshold for a Kazakhstan / NIS Grade 12 certificate. Kazakhstan is not in the BSc page's country selector ('Country or region not listed') and does not appear in the 2027 overseas-qualification requirements PDFs (A–I, J–Z). Default overseas route on the page lists IB Diploma 26 or GCE A Level/CIE BCC (three A-levels), each with IELTS 6.0 (no band <5.5); BSc is limited entry and applications are assessed individually.

gpa.quote: Minimum requirements listed here are the likely grades required and do not guarantee entry. We assess each application individually and applicants may require a higher grade to be offered a place.

Entry requirements are based on your prior study and we provide specific requirements for qualifications our international students have most frequently achieved.

scholarship_exists.how_found: International students > Scholarships, loans and funding > Undergraduate scholarships for international students; then the scholarship's own page.
scholarship_exists.notes: Weak fit: university-administered (donor-funded) undergraduate scholarship, one year, up to NZ$8,000, ONLY for students with disabilities; 2026 round 29 Jan–12 Mar 2026, so a 2027 round would fall after Semester One 2027 starts. Auckland lists no general merit scholarship for international first-year undergraduates applying directly from an overseas school: the International School Leaver Scholarship needs a NZ school, the Pathway awards need a foundation/NCUK route, and the International Student Excellence Scholarship is for master's students only. Regulations PDF not read.
